note: A rotation whose authorization has the authorizer's header kid and the right header typ and is signed by the key being bound; the possession is genuine. A key does not authorize its own binding by signing under another key's kid. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under its kind's header typ with its role's member as the header kid (spec 4.5); the keys the case publishes are its own log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
